cases.translation: The territory of Judah extended to the lands of Edom.
cases.explain: The preposition до (up to) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They came to Joshua, son of Nun.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The boundary went up to the peak of the mountain.
cases.explain: Verbs of motion like поднималась take the accusative case with к.

cases.translation: He drove out three Anakites from the city.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она просила воды у ___, его отца.
cases.translation: She asked for water from her father.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The boundary extended above the water.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Удел рода Иуды был огромен по ___.
cases.translation: The inheritance of Judah's tribe was enormous in size.
cases.explain: The preposition по (by, according to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Земля была поделена между ___ и морем.
cases.translation: The land was divided between mountains and the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Надел Иуды. Жеребий рода Иуды по их кланам простирался до земель Эдома, до пустыни Цин на самом юге.
reading.question: What territory did the inheritance of Judah extend to?
options: The lands of Edom and the wilderness of Zin in the south
The lands of Ephraim and the northern regions
The Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River
The lands of Benjamin and the hill country
reading.correct: The lands of Edom and the wilderness of Zin in the south
reading.explain: The text states the lot of Judah extended до земель Эдома, до пустыни Цин на самом юге (to the lands of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin in the south).

reading.ru: По повелению Господа Иисус дал Халеву, сыну Иефонии, земельный надел среди народа Иуды, Кириат-Арбу, то есть Хеврон.
reading.question: What city did Joshua give to Caleb in the territory of Judah?
reading.explain: The text says Joshua gave Caleb the city of Кириат-Арбу, то есть Хеврон (Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron).

reading.ru: Из Хеврона Халев прогнал трех анакитов, Шишая, Ахимана и Талмая, потомков Анака.
reading.question: Who did Caleb drive out from Hebron?
options: Three Anakites named Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai
Two hundred men and their families
reading.correct: Three Anakites named Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Халев прогнал трех анакитов, Шишая, Ахимана и Талмая (Caleb drove out three Anakites, Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai).

reading.ru: Халев сказал, «Я отдам свою дочь Ахсу в жены тому, кто нападет на Кириат-Сефер и возьмет его».
reading.question: What reward did Caleb offer for taking Kiriath Sepher?
reading.explain: The text says Я отдам свою дочь Ахсу в жены (I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage) to the one who takes Kiriath Sepher.

reading.ru: Она ответила, «Окажи мне особую милость, ты дал мне землю в Нигеве, так дай мне и источники воды».
reading.question: What did Achsah ask her father to give her after receiving the land?
reading.explain: Achsah asked дай мне и источники воды (give me springs of water) in addition to the land.

reading.ru: Иуда не смог выселить иевусеев, которые жили в Иерусалиме.
reading.question: Which people were Judah unable to drive out?
options: The Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem
The Canaanites of the coastal regions
reading.correct: The Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem
reading.explain: The text directly states Иуда не смог выселить иевусеев, которые жили в Иерусалиме (Judah could not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem).
